items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: Since the Partzuf of the Nekudim of SAG descended and clothed within the Partzuf from the Tabur downward of the inner AK, called the MA and BON of AK, Bina and Malchut joined with one another. For the Nekudim of SAG are the upper nine [Sefirot] — that is, Bina — and the TNHY of AK from the Tabur downward of the inner AK are the lower nine [Sefirot] — that is, Malchut. And then Bina took the form of Malchut, namely, the place of the restriction was made in Bina, and the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body, called Tifferet, and the coupling Malchut ascended to the Bina of the head, called the openings of the eyes. And this is called the second restriction. For the first restriction was only in Malchut, but the first nine were clean of any restriction. But now that the place of the restriction ascended to Bina, and the eyes — which are the Hochma of the head — were corrected together with Bina into the aspect of the Nukva, behold, all the last nine, from Hochma downward, are included in the restriction.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 2:2
items.html: And since the concluding Malchut ascended to the Chazeh, which is half of Tifferet, as above, behold, the vessels from the Chazeh downward went out into the aspect of an empty void, like the point of this world, which is because of the place of the first restriction. And these vessels, which were emptied of all light, became the place of BYA: from the two lower thirds [of Tifferet] was made the place of the world of Beriah, from NHY the place of Yetzirah, and from Malchut the place of Assiyah. (Items 2 to 6).
